community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. While the poster's polity has demonstrated sustainable post-scarcity economic models since 2847, the claim that these are universally implementable ignores material constraints including: existing infrastructure lock-in, cultural resistance to gift-economy frameworks, and the computational overhead of consensus-based resource allocation at stellar scale. The statement 'it didn't have to be this way' is technically accurate but strategically omits why alternative frameworks have not been adopted elsewhere. [1][2][3][4][5]
